records.operator_notes: JRA remains local-primary because final-program intake and human confirmation are bounded review steps. Reviewed import is the compatible fallback. Current candidate output supports A+ within the registered date-window route.

GitHub Actions is the primary NAR acquisition path with the local v2 runner as fallback. The registered route supports date windows, cross-month windows, selected meetings, source-visible horizons, and rank-upgrade retry while publication remains separately reviewed.

GitHub Actions is the primary Banei path with reviewed-import fallback. Current execution supports bounded date-window and selected-meeting detail acquisition plus rank-upgrade retry; cross-month and source-visible-horizon modes remain disabled.

HKJC remains provisional. GitHub Actions handles the schedule date-window route and explicit operator-reviewed import handles public-safe detail observations. Public output remains capped at A; fallback execution, generic selected-meeting retry, automatic approval, promotion, and publication remain disabled.

GitHub Actions supports the ERA source-visible schedule route and selected-meeting best-available detail acquisition up to A. Retry and review artifacts remain review-only; automatic approval, canonical/public writes, and unattended publication remain disabled.

GitHub Actions supports explicitly selected known KRA meetings at best available rank. Public output remains capped at A; date-window discovery, fallback execution, automatic approval, promotion, canonical/public writes, and unattended publication remain disabled.

GitHub Actions follows the official TJK current/future programme-page chain for a bounded 30-day window and evaluates each discovered domestic meeting through A+ timetable metadata. Observed evidence remains Best Available and may stay at C or A when richer fields are not published; complete rows with race name/condition, distance, surface/course label, and post time may reach A+. Publication remains capped separately at A and remains review-only.

The SOREC Programme Réunion index is wired as a meeting-discovery route and currently emits meeting-level evidence when no race times are present. That observation level is not a fixed rank ceiling: the system targets best available, canonical rank is derived centrally from evidence, public output may rise through A, and richer detail acquisition remains pending.

GitHub Actions reads Teletrak's source-visible weekly meeting cards and follows only real programme hrefs emitted by Teletrak. Published official programme documents are parsed into complete post-time rows and can produce A; meetings whose programme link is not yet published remain valid C with explicit pending detail, and retrieval/parser failures remain valid C with explicit retry state. The regular unified refresh re-evaluates the same source-visible meetings.

GitHub Actions combines HRI's annual official fixture list with the official Racecards monthly AJAX route. Every requested source month is re-evaluated on the regular full/near refresh cadence: published race rows can produce A, meetings without published rows remain valid C with explicit pending detail, and retrieval/parser failures remain explicit retry states. No lower rank is treated as complete merely because collection succeeded.

GitHub Actions scans the requested Peru-local date window through the official Monterrico date API, then resolves each discovered reunion through the official Monterrico reunion JSON API at /api/general/carreras/general/programas/{id_reunion}. The carreras array supplies continuous per-race post times, race names and distances through evidence-derived A. Unpublished or unavailable detail preserves the verified C meeting identity with explicit pending/retry state. Coverage is limited to the reviewed Monterrico system.

GitHub Actions resolves current JCSA Taif/Riyadh season bounds from official venue pages and checks each in-season date route. Complete race rows support evidence-derived A; meeting pages without published race rows remain valid C with pending publication. Missing meeting fingerprints are absent_unconfirmed only. Fetch/parse failures preserve existing verified state and remain explicit acquisition failures.

GitHub Actions reads the official FNCH regional programme indexes, attributes flat/obstacle/galop meetings to France Galop, and follows published official programme PDFs. Complete continuous per-race post times can produce A; unpublished detail remains valid C with pending publication, and retrieval/parser failures remain explicit retry states. FNCH visibility is treated as a source-visible horizon only, never proof of non-running.

GitHub Actions reads the official FNCH regional programme indexes, attributes trot meetings to LETROT, and follows published official programme PDFs. Complete continuous per-race post times can produce A; unpublished detail remains valid C with pending publication, and retrieval/parser failures remain explicit retry states. The FNCH route avoids treating a direct LETROT access failure as absence and never infers non-running from source invisibility.

GitHub Actions reads the latest official NZTR Racing Programme Guide as the Thoroughbred mother set and enriches currently published LOVERACING meeting-overview pages to complete per-race post times through rank A. Unpublished detail remains C/pending; acquisition failure preserves stronger verified state.

GitHub Actions prefers official HRNZ season/month Racing Dates and linked programme pages. When that live Infohorse route is blocked before any Harness rows are recovered, the same authority's official Final Racing Calendar PDF on www.hrnz.co.nz is the bounded fallback for meeting date, source-verified physical venue, and scheduled first-race time through rank B. Primary-route failure is retained as a recovered route diagnostic; unresolved venue or source absence is never evidence of non-running.

GitHub Actions selects the official BHA annual Fixture List PDF for the active year, extracts national flat/jump meeting date and racecourse observations at the system's current technical ceiling C, and overlays reviewed BHA transfer corrections where available. The registry detail slot intentionally points to the same C-only BHA fixture route because no richer reusable national race-time route is established. Race times are not inferred. Acquisition failure or source absence preserves stronger verified state and is never treated as non-running evidence.

GitHub Actions reads the official Závodisko 2026 national calendar and emits meeting date, verified timetable identity and official first-race time through B. The same reviewed calendar adapter supplies the implemented detail level; no stronger reusable full-calendar route is currently claimed. Source failure preserves stronger verified state and never confirms non-running.

GitHub Actions reads the official Bahrain Turf Club 2026/27 season programme as the meeting-date mother set for Rashid Equestrian & Horseracing Club and uses the official date-specific racecard navigation for complete per-race post times through rank A. An officially empty requested window is valid. Unpublished detail remains C/pending; acquisition or parser failure preserves stronger verified state and never proves non-running.

GitHub Actions reads the official Svensk Galopp 2026 race-day calendar PDF as the Swedish Thoroughbred meeting-date and venue mother set through rank C. Generic calendar event times remain source context only and are not promoted to first-race time. The profile remains provisional because explicit Första starttid event-page enrichment is known but no reusable detail source/adapter is connected; detail_source_id and detail_adapter_id therefore remain pending. Source failure preserves stronger verified state and never proves non-running.

GitHub Actions reads the official Deutscher Galopp 2026 annual calendar PDF as the gallop meeting-date and venue mother set, then enriches visible meetings from the official race-calendar table when per-race post times are published. Complete continuous timed rows can reach A; unpublished detail remains C/pending. Public country output remains capped at C because other German horse-racing codes are outside the reviewed scope. Source failure preserves stronger verified state and never proves non-running.

GitHub Actions reads the Jockey Club Español-approved Hipódromo de la Zarzuela autumn 2026 programme from the official JCE-linked Drive document. The same production route supplies and evaluates meeting identity/date through the declared technical capability C, satisfying both schedule and bounded detail-completion roles at C. The organizer jornada A-detail route is not production-connected while its TLS chain is not reliably reachable from GitHub Actions.

GitHub Actions discovers the latest official MASAF 2026 calendar modification, follows ALLEGATO n. 1, and emits the Italy MASAF gallop meeting-date/racecourse mother set through rank C. The detail slot intentionally points to the same C-only official calendar route because no reusable national race-time route is established. Source failure preserves stronger verified state and never proves non-running.

GitHub Actions discovers the latest official MASAF 2026 calendar modification, follows ALLEGATO n. 1, and emits the Italy MASAF trot meeting-date/racecourse mother set through rank C. The detail slot intentionally points to the same C-only official calendar route because no reusable national race-time route is established. Source failure preserves stronger verified state and never proves non-running.

GitHub Actions parses the current official Race Coast KZN & Western Cape fixtures page and emits meeting-date/racecourse observations at rank C. Greyville turf/poly labels map to one physical racecourse. 4Racing is routed separately from the jointly maintained national fixture PDF. Source failure preserves stronger verified state and never proves non-running.

GitHub Actions parses the jointly maintained South Africa 2026 National Fixtures PDF and emits the 4Racing Turffontein, Vaal and Fairview meeting-date/racecourse mother set at rank C. Course variants map to physical venues. Race Coast remains a separate operator route. Source failure preserves stronger verified state and never proves non-running.

GitHub Actions parses the current official Programa Oficial category and emits source-visible meeting-date/Hipódromo Presidente Remón observations at rank C. Calendar/event hours are never used as post times. The source-visible horizon is not negative evidence for unlisted dates; fetch or parse failure preserves stronger verified state.
Automatic JCB Reuniões route for Gávea; date+venue only at rank C. Source omission is not negative evidence.
Automatic JCB Reuniões distributor route for Cristal; JCRGS remains operator authority. Date+venue only at rank C. Source omission is not negative evidence.

Automatic JCSP monthly Projeto de Inscrições discovery and PDF parser. Publishes meeting date plus Cidade Jardim physical venue at rank C only. Missing future monthly PDFs are publication-state warnings, not non-running evidence.
Automatic annual-calendar PDF route for Sorocaba. Publishes exact meeting date plus physical venue at rank C only; programme timing remains separate.

GitHub Actions follows the official HVC Panfletos index and parses relevant monthly PDFs into rank C meeting-date observations. Missing future monthly publication or fetch/parse failure never proves non-running.
Automatic official Programas HTML route. Publishes only source-visible meeting date plus Hipódromo de las Américas at rank C; missing future programmes are not negative evidence.

GitHub Actions follows the official HRU/Maroñas monthly calendar and parses only exact Maroñas / Las Piedras venue cells into rank C meeting-date observations. Overseas simulcast rows in the same PDF are excluded. Missing future monthly publication or fetch/parse failure never proves non-running.

Automatic Suomen Hippos current-year HTML calendar route for the 19 current main tracks in the Racecourse Master denominator. Seasonal non-master tracks and Paikallisravit local/temporary meetings are explicitly diagnosed as out-of-scope rather than silently published. Published meeting clock is retained only as context and is not promoted to first-race time.

Automatic Caymanas Park Entries route. Direct API requests from GitHub Actions currently receive the SPA shell, so the runner falls back to the official Entries page rendered with the system Chrome already present on the GitHub-hosted runner. Publishes meeting date plus the single physical racecourse at rank C only. Missing later dates/months are publication-state limits, not non-running evidence.

Automatic official Dostihy.cz national calendar route. Event detail pages provide meeting date and venue tags; nine reviewed Czech racecourse labels are mapped to physical identities. General event timing is not promoted to race post time.

Automatic official Klampenborg Galopbane source-visible calendar route. Publishes meeting date plus the single physical racecourse at rank C; displayed general event time is not treated as race post time. This is venue-specific coverage and does not claim complete Denmark-wide racing coverage.

Automatic official Kincsem Park Galopp calendar route. Publishes Thoroughbred meeting date plus Kincsem Park physical identity at rank C. Harness and greyhound meetings are outside this automatic route. Existing reviewed A programme capability remains a separate richer/manual path and is not downgraded.

Automatic official DNT Løpsdagskalender route. Publishes harness meeting date and physical racecourse at rank C. Entry deadline text is not a post time; absence/fetch failure is not non-running evidence.
Automatic official Øvrevoll fixture route. Publishes gallop meeting date and Øvrevoll physical identity at rank C. Published event start is context only and is not a first-race post time.

Automatic official Krieau race-date route. Publishes meeting date plus Trabrennpark Krieau physical identity at rank C. General event start time is context only, not a race post time. Separate reviewed race newspapers retain richer A-capability evidence.

Automatic official Hrvatski Galopski Savez current-season route. Publishes Hipodrom Zagreb meeting date plus physical identity at rank C. Current-season page takes precedence over the older annual calendar. Race post times are not inferred.

Automatic official Belgrade current-season route. Publishes meeting date plus Belgrade Hippodrome physical identity at rank C. Reviewed detailed season schedules remain a separate richer evidence path and are not downgraded.
Automatic official Suisse Trot calendar route. Publishes source-visible trot meeting date plus physical venue at C. Event start context is not promoted to race post time.
Automatic official Galop Suisse plus IENA current-event route. Publishes source-visible gallop meeting date plus physical venue at C. Event start context is not promoted to race post time.

Automatic official NDR current-upcoming route. Publishes meeting date plus mapped physical venue at rank C. Permanent tracks and temporary kortebaan street venues are distinct identities. Unknown venue labels fail closed. Annual NDR 2026 calendar remains a reviewed fallback.

Automatic official PKWK 2026 national-plan route for Warszawa-Służewiec, Wrocław-Partynice and Hipodrom Sopot. Publishes meeting date plus physical racecourse at rank C. Race post times are not inferred; source absence is not non-running evidence.

Automatic official CSM Ploiesti notice route. Publishes meeting date plus Hipodromul Ploiesti physical identity at rank C. Publication dates are never treated as meeting dates. Separate reviewed B-capability first-race-time evidence is retained.

Automatic official MRA 2026 national fixture route for current MRA associated clubs Selangor Turf Club and Perak Turf Club. PDF color legend maps yellow to Selangor and green to Perak; exact fixture totals are validated 61/29/90. Publishes meeting date plus physical racecourse at rank C. Race post times are not inferred.

Automatic official Nicosia Race Club monthly schedule route. Publishes meeting date plus Nicosia Racecourse physical identity at rank C. Performance Start Time is deliberately not interpreted as race post time; source absence is not non-running evidence.

Automatic official federation trotting programme route for source-visible Mons, Waregem and Tongeren meetings. Publishes meeting date plus physical venue at rank C. Existing reviewed countrywide A-capability evidence remains separate; source absence is not non-running evidence.

Automatic official Horse Racing Belize 2026 schedule route across Peter August Stadium, People's Stadium and Castleton Race Track. Publishes meeting date plus mapped physical venue at rank C only. Schedule absence or acquisition failure is not non-running evidence.

Automatic official Hipódromo Camarero Inscripciones route emits source-visible local meeting dates at the fixed physical venue at rank C. Reviewed programme/PDF evidence remains a separate richer detail capability and is not inferred by the discovery runner. Empty future weekly shells and source absence are not non-running evidence.

Automatic QREC public frontend/API route. The runner resolves Al Rayyan and Al Uqda from source-visible meeting names, filters API over-return locally to the requested window, treats 00:00 as unpublished, and upgrades C/B/B+/A only from valid source-visible post times.

Automatic Barbados Turf Club annual-calendar route emits source-visible meeting dates at the fixed Garrison Savannah venue at rank C. Programme-level post times remain a separate reviewed detail capability. Explicit CANCELLED labels are not emitted as positive meetings; absence never proves non-running.

Automatic official Arima Race Club 2026 fixture-list route emits source-visible meeting dates at the fixed Santa Rosa Park venue at rank C. Programme-level post times remain a separate reviewed A-capability source. Source absence never proves non-running.

Automatic official Carrere annual-calendar route emits source-visible meeting dates at the fixed Hippodrome de Carrere venue at rank C. Published meeting Horaire is not interpreted as first-race post time. Source absence never proves non-running.

Automatic official KZS 2026 Koledar route emits current-window meeting dates only after organizer labels are mapped to independently verified physical racecourses. Unknown future organizers are rejected; race times are not inferred.
